explanation: 6 × 7 × 10⁹ × 80,000 = 3.36 × 10¹⁵ FLOP/s achieved, against 8 × 10¹⁵ peak: 42%. The 6 counts 2 FLOPs per parameter in the forward pass and 4 in the backward pass. MFU counts only the model's FLOPs, so recomputation from activation checkpointing does not raise it (the *hardware* FLOPs utilization, HFU, would include it). 42% is respectable; the next exercise asks what you would do at 20%.
